scope: Targeted source tracing of the active base-XMB presentation/input path and its settings/modal/artwork boundaries. This is not a claim that all 12,050 lines of XMBViewModel or every application feature were read.

active_path.evidence: Release host calls XMBShellContainer. XMBShell.kt:140-222 collects lifecycle-aware uiState and supplies explicit callbacks into stateless XMBShell.

Theme/icons shared through composition locals; scale bounded by smaller screen-axis ratio; base fontScale preserved; covered/non-visible/power-throttled backgrounds freeze; original two-fold fallback lives in XmbBackground.kt:237-345.
Fixed anchor and indexed unbounded row under clip; geometry snap separate from animated category slide; selected label only, scale/alpha focus. Drilled mode removes categories to the right.

Category transition composes outgoing/incoming layers; only current category can show focus. Parent passes columnKey, landingToken, scrollToTopToken into item list. Drilled game list uses XmbDrillFlyout instead.

Whole rows below fixed anchor; separate half-row above category bar; each row keyed by item identity and composed once; explicit transit-band/window/bottom clipping; selected/inactive scale and label shadow.
New view/landing/move snaps; >3-row jump snaps one row short; glide100ms/row capped200ms. Separate Rewind handoff constants80/30/40/200ms were inspected but not recommended for wholesale import.

ID-based refresh focus with nearest-index fallback; per-view remembered cursor; shared touch/controller item movement; overlays consume input first; category bounds clamp, left backs out of drill and right stays within drill.

Press/release handling,80ms duplicate suppression,analog hysteresis,newest-axis direction,repeat ramp/full-tilt fast path,cancel-repeat preserving held-edge state. Current SDL already has release gates/hysteresis; no new process/input owner warranted.
Readiness/lock/modal stack and stable-key focus engine inspected. Base XMB movement itself remains in XMBViewModel; do not claim this engine alone is its crossbar implementation.

Display mode resolves actual art type; natural aspect ratio from decoded intrinsic size; explicit load size avoids async constraint deadlock; error and loading remain distinct. ArtworkImage delegates to Coil3.

Per-image focus/on-screen/allowed motion gate. MotionGate.kt was read; keeps animation control separate from image reloading. image/ArtworkRevisions.kt was read and supplies URI revision/cache-key invalidation for writes at the same path.

Resets XMB-only density before SettingsNavHost. SettingsNavHost.kt:1-90 routes allowlisted screens; SettingsScaffold.kt:530-640 measures full focused-row bounds and restores focus after modal close;1180-1238 uses naturally wrapping label/helper text.

Two-line measured title precedes underline; selected row follows viewport; text values ellipsize separately. PspMenuNav.kt was read: clamp,no wrap,Back climbs/close,shared cues. PfpModalHost.kt:186-257 binds long-message scroll and modal action ownership.

Prompts resolve actual action mappings,drop unbound actions,and support paired inputs. ControllerHintBar.kt read in full: consistent small shadowed hints,200ms idle fade-in and immediate dismissal. XMBShell.kt:1680-1703 places keyboard above modal layers.

bounded_findings.finding: Snap when pagination replaces the row coordinate space; same offset reorders/replacements also change geometry.
bounded_findings.comparison: SDL _items identity originally omitted offset and row IDs. Root now adds both, preserving ordinary subtitle/favorite changes.
bounded_findings.verification: project/tests/test_ui_motion.py adds draw-call tests for nextpage39->0,previouspage0->39,same-offset replacement/reorder,and field-only changes. Four failures reproduced before fix; all7 tests pass after fix.

bounded_findings.finding: Use bounded multiline options headers so a long game title remains identifiable.
bounded_findings.comparison: Implemented measured two-line SDL side-sheet header and full overflow title in paged body. Two real-renderer layout tests cover complete two-line titles and all message pages at text_scale=1.75 with four choices. Active base-XMB list labels retain ellipsis; no marquee reuse claim.

bounded_findings.finding: When focused item disappears, retain nearest remaining row instead of jumping to top.
bounded_findings.comparison: SDL _Page.replace keeps selected ID or nearest remaining row for same-view refreshes. Settings response handlers compare prior view to response context before assignment: entering hardware/control/appearance/combined matching starts at0; same-screen refresh keeps focus. Root/back restores the explicit parent ID. Empty lists and explicit fresh queries/pages select0.
bounded_findings.regression_correction: Full-host run found shared Settings page entry inheriting parent index. Corrected all four settings-subview transition handlers with explicit same-view focus preservation; CommonSettingsFlowTests regression passes.

followups_not_implemented: ArtworkRevisions has an explicit per-path cache revision. SDL caches positive/negative artwork by path; external scraper replacement at same path needs a coordinator-driven invalidation signal, not stat/file I/O inside render.

PFP global fontScale survives XMB scale resets. SDL fixed-grid keyboard currently uses fixed font sizes independently of text_scale. Any larger-key-label change should validate special labels and all forty key cells at largest supported scale.
Original vectors and existing isolated runtime authorities remain preferred; no Compose framework or third-party artwork imported.
licensing_observation: Pinned PFP README links LICENSE but no root license file was found. User-supplied permission is recorded by parent; controller/category asset provenance is separate. This report does not assert a permissive source license.
